claims.scope: 2Re a=(pi/2)|b|^2 on the boundary; Toeplitz compression plus analytic multiplication hyponormality proves D>=0 with the exact supplied orientation.
Self-adjoint strict contractions T_i on one common H; real-coefficient multiplier adjoint identity gives exact N_ij=K_Ti*(D tensor I)K_Tj. Norm convergence and block PSD proved.
K_ij=2S_iN_ijS_j is a positive congruence even with negative/singular S_i; no cross-index commutativity needed.
Exact factor2 identity and unique bounded solution through left-right strict contraction; never divides by S_i.
For scalar X1=1,X2=2,v=(2,-1), v*Rv=-4[2sinh(1/2)-sinh(1)]^2<0. This refutes only raw-R PSD/positivity-transfer, not tool1.
Exact scalar identity f=4sqrt(t)k(.5ln t) and exact 4/pi integral coefficient; sqrt-lambda integral pi/[2(1+sqrt(t))^2].
Strictly positive density for every lambda>=0; sigma-finite measure with convergent combined resolvent integrand, although total mass is infinite.
On (0,infinity), positive norm-convergent integration of q_lambda(t)=(t-1)^2/(t+lambda); inverse convexity plus affine part. No singular-zero or k-operator-convexity claim.
No unrelated M>=0, general J>=2E, all-KMS weak regularity, or endpoint closure proved by these tools.
